project_type: npm workspaces monorepo: Express API (apps/api) + React/Vite web (apps/web) + Expo mobile (apps/mobile)
language: JavaScript only — NO TypeScript, no .ts/.tsx files ever
build_system: npm workspaces; root package.json has workspace scripts. Key quirk: tailwind.config.js uses ESM export default, postcss.config.js uses CJS module.exports.
test_framework: vitest in apps/web (npm run test -w @llah/web); API has no test suite yet — just run node syntax checks
build_command: npm run build -w @llah/web  (web only needed for verification)
verification_instructions: 1) For API JS changes: cd apps/api && node --input-type=module < src/config/env.js  (or node -e import check). 2) For web changes: npm run build -w @llah/web must exit 0. 3) Dev smoke test: npm run dev:api + npm run dev:web, open http://localhost:5173/dashboard.
snapshot_or_generated_files: package-lock.json is regenerated when you run npm install. Commit it.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell shell. Do not use bash-specific syntax. Absolute worktree path: c:\Users\Coding-Kimz\Desktop\crazy\llah. Never write outside that path.
contribution_requirements: AGENT-START-HERE.md: JS only, Tailwind only (no MUI/Chakra/Bootstrap), one module at a time, no fake completion, text-first calm UI, money never in floating point.
key_patterns: API calls in web pages use `import { api } from '../lib/api'` (NOT useAuth().api — Customers.jsx pattern). Org ID from localStorage.getItem('current_organization_id'). State: useState + useEffect. API auto-injects auth + x-organization-id headers. Tailwind custom tokens: canvas, ink, line, muted, success, warning, danger, brand.*. Custom classes: llah-card, llah-input, llah-button, llah-table, btn-primary, btn-secondary, input. PageHeader component at components/ui/PageHeader.jsx accepts {title, description, action}.
directory_structure: llah/ — root (docs, prisma/, packages/). apps/api/src/ — config/, lib/, middleware/, modules/<name>/{router,service,repository,validators}.js, routes.js (mounts all routers). apps/web/src/ — pages/, components/ui/, contexts/, layouts/, lib/, router.jsx, main.jsx, styles.css.
